goal: Speed up native Windows builds and node validation by switching the compiler from MSVC to clang-cl
Drop persistent MSVC compiler workarounds and enable inline assembly optimizations on Windows
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now despite conflicts with master because the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Substantive support with no blocking objections (maflcko, hodlinator)
Verified by testing native Windows build and CMake flags (hodlinator)
Support for potential codegen improvements and better build compatibility (maflcko)
Objection to maintaining two compilers resolved by dropping MSVC entirely (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because native Windows CI build times drop by roughly 38 percent
Validation microbenchmarks show substantial speedups of up to 55 percent
Removes persistent workarounds for MSVC bugs and enables future inline assembly
